name: OxaPay Crypto Payment Gateway for Easy Digital Downloads
author: OxaPay

sections.description:
OxaPay is a modern cryptocurrency payment gateway that enables Easy Digital Downloads (EDD) stores to accept digital asset payments securely and efficiently. The plugin integrates seamlessly with EDD, allowing merchants to offer crypto payments without complex configuration or technical overhead.

By using OxaPay, store owners can expand their payment options, reach a global audience, and process blockchain-based transactions through a single, unified gateway.

Supported Cryptocurrencies

The OxaPay payment gateway supports a wide range of popular cryptocurrencies, including:

  • Bitcoin (BTC)
  • Ethereum (ETH)
  • BNB (BNB)
  • TRON (TRX)
  • Tether (USDT)
  • USD Coin (USDC)
  • Litecoin (LTC)
  • Bitcoin Cash (BCH)
  • Dogecoin (DOGE)
  • Monero (XMR)
  • Solana (SOL)
  • Polygon (MATIC)
  • Shiba Inu (SHIB)
  • Toncoin (TON)
  • Notcoin (NOT)
  • DOGS (DOGS)
  • Ripple (XRP)

All supported assets are managed through your OxaPay merchant account.

Key Features

  • Seamless integration with Easy Digital Downloads
  • Fast blockchain payment processing
  • Support for multiple cryptocurrencies through a single gateway
  • Automatic payment confirmation and order processing
  • Optional automatic withdrawal scheduling via OxaPay dashboard
  • Clean and user-friendly checkout experience
  • Secure transaction handling through OxaPay infrastructure

Low Transaction Fees

OxaPay applies a transparent transaction fee of 0.4%, offering a cost-effective alternative to traditional payment processors.

Secure and Reliable

Security is a core principle of OxaPay. All payment requests are processed through OxaPay’s secure API, and blockchain confirmations are monitored automatically to ensure accurate order status updates.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services provided by OxaPay to:
* Create and manage cryptocurrency payment requests
* Monitor blockchain payment confirmations
* Update order statuses automatically

Transaction requests are sent to:
https://api.oxapay.com/v1/payment/invoice

Support

Documentation and setup guides are available at OxaPay Plugin For Easy Digital Downloads.

For technical assistance or questions, contact OxaPay support.

Terms

This service is provided by OxaPay. Usage is subject to OxaPay’s terms of service.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Install and activate the OxaPay Crypto Payment Gateway plugin.
  3. Log in to your OxaPay merchant dashboard and generate your Merchant API key.
  4. Enter the API key in Easy Digital Downloads → Payment Gateways → OxaPay.
  5. Save settings and start accepting cryptocurrency payments.
sections.faq:
How does the OxaPay payment gateway work?

The plugin connects your Easy Digital Downloads store to the OxaPay payment infrastructure. When a customer selects OxaPay at checkout, a payment request is created and processed on the blockchain. Once the transaction is confirmed, the order status is updated automatically.

What information is sent to OxaPay?

The plugin sends the Merchant API key, order ID, payment amount, and selected cryptocurrency in order to process the transaction.

Do customers need an OxaPay account to pay?

No. Customers can complete payments using their own cryptocurrency wallets without creating an OxaPay account.

Which cryptocurrencies are supported?

All cryptocurrencies supported by the OxaPay platform are available for use within Easy Digital Downloads, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and others.
